core.title: Parthenon Double Cylinder Handleset With Georgian Knob, Schlage F62PAR
tags: schlage f series Double cylinder handlesets

text.description_html:
Schlage F62PAR, Ornate Parthenon Double Cylinder Handleset With Georgian Knob

Ornately decorated, Schlage's Parthenon Double Cylinder Handleset is a beautiful example of the exquisite style one might find on the elegant homes of the Hamptons. The georgina knobonly adds to its beauty, the hlaf-round knob the perfect accent to the higly decorated handleset. It is made to install easily, with an adjustable latch that will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets. It will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4" thick door. The antique brass finish only brings out the old world beauty of this handleset. A double cylinder handleset, it is locked and unlocked by a key on both sides of the door. This type of lock is most often used on doors located near windows.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt on this double cylinder handleset is thrown or retracted by a key from the both the exterior and the interior. The latch is retracted by a thumbpiece from the exterior and by a turn knob on the interior.

Also available matching:
Parthenon Single Cylinder Handleset
Parthenon Dummy Handleset

Features of the Schlage Parthenon Handleset:

  • ANSI A156.5 Grade 1 security.
  • Easy installation.
  • All metal chassis for strength and durability.
  • 3 screw door frame reinforcer.
  • Guaranteed to fit all standard door preparations.
  • C keyway comes packaged with 2 keys.

Specifications of the Double Cylinder Parthenon Handleset:

  • Finish: Antique Brass
  • Overall Outside Handle Length: 12-2/5"
  • Outside Handle Projection: 2-1/10"
  • Outside Deadbolt Plate Length: 3-3/10"
  • Outside Deadbolt Plate Width: 2"
  • Outside Top Handle Plate Length: 4"
  • Outside Top Handle Plate Width: 2-2/5"
  • Outside Bottom Handle Plate Length: 3-3/10"
  • Outside Bottom Handle Plate Width: 2"
  • Backset: will fit 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: will fit 1-5/8" up to 1-3/4" packaged with extra screws to accommodate 2" doors
  • 5-1/2" center to center deadbolt to latch spacing
  • Adjustable throughbolt can move up and down 1-1/2" to fit a variety of pre-existing holes

The handleset is only available in Antique Brass (609) finish with the Georgian Knob (GEO).
